about: Oracle Financial Services Software Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides information technology (IT) solutions to the financial services industry worldwide. It operates in two segments, Product Licenses and Related Activities; and IT Solutions and Consulting Services. The company offers Oracle FLEXCUBE; Oracle FLEXCUBE Investor Servicing; Oracle Banking Digital Experience; Oracle Financial Services Lending and Leasing; and Oracle Banking APIs.
